caption: When the clock factory workers finally went back to work, everyone said it was ____.
scene: A row of relieved workers clocking in under a wall crowded with clocks, each showing a different time.
altText: Factory workers file in beneath a wall covered in clocks.

caption: The electrician always read the paper first thing; she liked to keep up with ____.
scene: An electrician in overalls sits on a toolbox reading a newspaper, a coil of cable over her shoulder, sparks fizzing from an open fuse box behind her.
altText: An electrician reads a newspaper beside a sparking fuse box.

caption: The fishermen's band sounded thin until they finally added a good ____.
scene: Three fishermen in waders play instruments on a dock; one proudly holds a fishing rod like a guitar with a large fish on the hook.
altText: Fishermen play music on a dock, one strumming a fishing rod.

caption: The restaurant on the moon had wonderful food, but the critic said it had no ____.
scene: A food critic in a space helmet sits at a candlelit table on the moon, a waiter in a spacesuit floating a tray toward him, Earth in the sky.
altText: A diner in a space helmet is served dinner on the moon.

caption: The old cobbler loved his work. Every pair of shoes got his ____.
scene: A smiling cobbler at a cluttered workbench holds up a finished boot, shelves of shoes behind him.
altText: A cobbler proudly holds up a boot at his workbench.

caption: The maths teacher's vegetable garden was famous for its ____.
scene: A teacher in a cardigan pulls a perfectly cube-shaped carrot from a tidy vegetable bed while a neighbor stares over the fence.
altText: A gardener pulls a cube-shaped carrot from the soil as a neighbor looks on.

caption: The scarecrow won the farm's top award. Everyone agreed he was ____ in his field.
scene: A scarecrow wearing a first-prize ribbon stands in a wheat field while crows politely applaud from a fence.
altText: A scarecrow wearing a prize ribbon stands in a field as crows clap.

caption: The baker quit making doughnuts. He said he was tired of the ____.
scene: A weary baker slumps beside a tray of doughnuts, peering at a customer through the hole of one he is holding up.
altText: A tired baker peers through a doughnut he is holding up.

caption: The tomato turned bright red when it walked in on the ____.
scene: A blushing tomato covers its eyes at an open fridge door where a bowl of lettuce is pulling on a tiny coat.
altText: A blushing tomato covers its eyes at an open fridge.

caption: The gardener wasn't sure about the job at first, but she had ____.
scene: A gardener in a sun hat stands knee-deep in an enormous overgrown pumpkin patch, a watering can in hand, vines curling around her boots.
altText: A gardener stands among giant pumpkin vines with a watering can.
